item.title: Wails v3 Beta: A New Foundation for Go Desktop Apps
item.description: Wails v3 Beta introduces a more direct application model, richer bindings, and a clearer foundation for Go desktop applications. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Wireblast: A 100Gbps Packet Generator in Go
item.description: If you’ve followed my blog for a while, you know I love tinkering with packets and making them go fast in software. Today I'm releasing a new tool called wireblast, a blazingly fast network packet generator. (1 source: golangweekly)
